title: fix(ui): condition editors offer a multiple: true field only what its evaluator answers
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XP3RHGWUG7UH3fNa4tBa9UC)_

Part of #35992 — the condition-editor half. The dashboard filter bar half is left open on the card: it is built on its own branch under the same claim, route A per seat note 7066557346 (see Acceptance notes).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在工作室里给"多选"字段（例如可选多人的负责人字段）写条件时，下拉框现在只给"包含 / 不包含 / 为空 / 不为空"，不再给一定出错或算错的"等于 / 属于"；仪表盘筛选栏这一半没改。
- 属于"多值字段筛选"这组修复，接着上一张让列表筛选支持多值字段的卡做完条件编辑器部分。
- 影响写共享规则条件、数据集筛选、关联列表筛选和流程分支条件的管理员；只改界面给出的选项，已存的条件原样不动，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做的一件事：无。仪表盘筛选栏那一半已由席位定为路线 A（可选的 DataSource 读数据集定义），在同卡另一分支施工。

## What changes

A `select` / `lookup` / `user` field declared `multiple: true` stores a list. The condition editors built their field lists without `multiple`, so the shared `FilterBuilder` treated such a field as single-value and offered `Equals` / `Is any of`. Each editor's evaluator was measured first (below); every one of them refuses or mis-answers those operators, so each now passes `multiple` and the builder offers `jsonColumnFilterOperators`' set (Contains, Does not contain, Is empty, Is not empty). No operator table is copied: every surface asks `operatorsForField` / `jsonColumnFilterOperators`.

| Editor | Evaluator | Measured on a list-valued field | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@object-ui/fields` `FilterConditionField` (sharing-rule criteria, roll-up filters) | engine `find` (data door) | `=` and `$in`: 400 `INVALID_FILTER`; `$contains`, `$or` of `$contains`: rows | passes `multiple` |
| Studio `FilterConditionField` + `datasetFilterCondition` (dataset scope / measure filter) | `POST /analytics/dataset/query` | `=` and `$in`: **200 with a count of 0**; `$contains` / `$notContains` / `$empty`: right counts | passes `multiple`; read-back asks `operatorsForField`, so a stored `$eq` / `$in` there opens in Source instead of as an `equals` row |
| same editor, a field's `relatedListFilter` | data door | as the first row | passes `multiple` |
| Studio flow edge rows (`flow-edge-condition-rows`) | `celEngine` (CEL) | `S == 'u1'` false for `['u1','u2']`; `S.contains('u1')` faults (no overload for list); `'u1' in S` true | passes `multiple`; `contains` / `not_contains` on a list write `S != null && V in S` / `S == null \|\| !(V in S)` and read back; offered set read from `operatorsForField` |

The flow rows and the CEL `ConditionBuilder` read their fields from `useObjectFields`, which now carries the served `multiple` (one more read of the same payload, like `required` / `system`).

Read first, by risk:

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-edge-condition-rows.ts` — the membership spellings and the two new read-back patterns (`celToRows` adopts a guard only when `rowsToCel` re-writes it byte for byte).
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/datasetFilterCondition.ts` — `builderHolds` / `readBackOperator` now ask `operatorsForField(type, multiple)`; a stored `$in` on a list field stops opening as a row.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/useObjectFields.ts` — the `multiple` projection. It also makes `ConditionBuilder`'s existing multi-value 「is empty」 arm reachable from the hook path (it was reachable only through a `fields` prop).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-edge-condition-rows.multiValue-35992.test.ts`. Expect 12 passed. Each spelling there is evaluated by `celEngine`.

## Tests

New files named for the card:

- `flow-edge-condition-rows.multiValue-35992.test.ts`: the offered set is the helper's. Contains and Does not contain write membership, read back, and the engine answers them on a list, on null, and as any-of. The `==` control is false. A single-value column keeps its equality spelling.
- `FlowEdgeInspector.multiValue-35992.test.tsx`: a membership guard on a `multiple: true` user column opens as one row. Its real operator dropdown lists exactly Contains / Does not contain / Is empty / Is not empty.
- `datasetFilterCondition.multiValue-35992.test.tsx`: both field catalogs (`buildFieldOptions`, `useObjectFields`) mark exactly the `multiple: true` columns. `$contains` / `$notContains` / `$empty` open as rows, and `$eq` / `$in` go to Source. Single-value controls still open `$eq` / `$in` as rows.
- `FilterConditionField.multipleField-35992.test.tsx` (fields): a `multiple: true` user / lookup / select column's real operator dropdown equals `operatorsForField`'s labels. Single-value controls keep Equals.

<details><summary>Reverse verification (source at base, new tests kept)</summary>

Committed first. The nine source files were then restored to the base `30b0987c` with the new tests kept: **19 failed / 10 passed** (the passing 10 are the single-value controls and the refusal rows). Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`. `git diff HEAD` came back empty, and all nine `git hash-object` values matched the HEAD blobs.
</details>

<details><summary>Affected suites</summary>

`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/useObjectFields.draftOverlay-11895.test.tsx packages/fields/src/widgets/__tests__/` → Test Files 279 passed (279), Tests 3679 passed, 1 skipped (3680). The full `@object-ui/app-shell` / `@object-ui/fields` suites are CI's (`Test UI`).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Dashboard filter bar: not in this PR.** `buildFilterCondition` lowers a select / lookup global filter to `=` / `$in` with no knowledge of the bound field. That field's definition is not reachable at the binding site. A dataset-bound widget learns its base object only from its own query's answer (`AnalyticsResult.object`; `DashboardView` says the same), and the `DataSource` interface has no read for a dataset's definition. The seat ruled route A for it (seat note 7066557346): an optional `DataSource` member that reads a dataset definition, built on its own branch under the same claim.
- **Premise correction, measured:** on the dashboard's door, `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` on `showcase_project_metrics` with `runtimeFilter: { labels: 'frontend' }` or `{ labels: { $in: [...] } }`, the server does not refuse with 400. It answers 200 with a count of 0 (SqlDriver, better-sqlite3). The data door refuses the same filters with 400. `$contains` gives 2, an `$or` of two `$contains` gives 3, and the substring `fron` gives 0, so this is real membership. That difference between the two doors is tracked as #36168, not fixed here.
- The CEL `ConditionBuilder` (hook conditions, action visibility, page-block visibility) is not on the shared builder. On a list subject its `==` / `!=` give a constant answer, measured with `celEngine`, and `validateExpression` accepts `record.labels == 'frontend'` with no warning. It is tracked as #36167; its fix needs a membership operator in that builder, which is out of this card's mechanism.
- The Studio view / page-block filter (`FilterBuilderField` in `metadata-admin/widgets.tsx`) builds its fields without `multiple` too. It is outside this claim's file surface and is tracked as #36169.

</details>
